_help: ID check page (idcheck.php): shown after payment when the automatic Vouched check (crosscheck + DOB) didn't verify the visitor. The Vouched plugin is mounted in the page; assets/idcheck.js sends the result to submit.php?action=idcheck.
title: Verify your identity

text.heading: Please verify your identity
text.intro: Your order is placed. To finish, we need a quick photo of your ID and a selfie, so your clinician can confirm it's you.
text.failed_text: Please try again with a clear photo of a valid government ID, or contact support and we'll help you finish.
text.unavailable: Identity verification is not available right now. Please contact support to complete your order.
